title.narrative: Capacity Improvement of the Kampala Northern by pass

description.narrative: Under this project 17.5km of 2-lane carriageway will be constructed, to be added to the 3.5km already constructed under the already completed Kampala Northern Bypass (KNB) phase I. Other capacity improvements will be through provision of grade separated intersections, pedestrian walkways and footbridges etc. The full length of the KNB is 21km.
